name: Ōsakikamijima (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ōsakikamijima town emblem in light blue and green: a light blue disc bearing a green stylised figure with leaves.
history: Municipal flag of Ōsakikamijima, a town in Hiroshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 5 August 2003.

features.role: Ōsakikamijima town emblem — a light blue disc bearing a green stylised figure with leaves
